beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut scene of a simple island meal beside a small cooking fire, with carved sunburst-like energy rays rising from the food and fire without symbols or text.
beats.purpose: show that food provides usable energy for the body
beats.visual_fingerprint: medium close view of cooked island food and glowing cooking fire on sun-bleached sand, low three-quarter camera angle, hard tropical daylight, radiating carved energy shapes dominating the upper frame
beats.continuity: begin the nutrition explanation with a concrete island meal before expanding to what energy alone does not provide

beats.narration_slice: Health also needs vitamins, minerals, protein, and fats.
beats.visual: Overhead full-bleed linocut composition of a varied tropical spread containing fish, coconut, leafy greens, fruit, roots and shellfish arranged naturally on a woven mat, emphasizing diversity without labels.
beats.purpose: show that health depends on multiple kinds of nutrients supplied by varied foods
beats.visual_fingerprint: top-down wide shot of six visibly different tropical food groups on a rough woven mat, turquoise shoreline entering one corner, balanced radial composition, bright hard daylight
beats.continuity: expand from the single energy-giving meal to a visibly broader range of foods that supplies different nutritional needs

beats.narration_slice: Eating only a few foods may still leave nutrient gaps.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut of three identical repeated meals set in a row on bare sand while several empty food impressions and vacant spaces surround them, visually suggesting missing variety without text.
beats.purpose: show how a repetitive diet can leave nutritional needs unmet
beats.visual_fingerprint: oblique medium-wide shot of three nearly identical coconut-and-starch meals receding diagonally across bare beach, conspicuous empty carved silhouettes around them, sparse composition with bone-white negative shapes
beats.continuity: contrast the previous varied spread with a repetitive, visibly incomplete food pattern to pay off the opening question

beats.narration_slice: Over time, those gaps can cause health problems.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut still life of the same limited food supply now weathered beside a drooping island plant and a cracked, weakened wooden tool, using gradual deterioration as a non-medical metaphor for deficiency over time.
beats.purpose: show that persistent nutrient gaps can lead to worsening health
beats.visual_fingerprint: low-angle close still life under storm-muted light, wilted leaves and cracked wooden tool beside repetitive food remnants, darker indigo shadows and sparse rust-orange stress accents
beats.continuity: carry the idea of missing nutrients forward in time by replacing empty spaces with visible signs of gradual decline

beats.narration_slice: Fresh plants may add nutrients those repeated meals miss.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut close view of hands gathering fresh edible-looking island greens and fruit from a lush patch beside the beach, with the repetitive meal supply distant and secondary.
beats.purpose: show fresh plant foods adding dietary variety and nutrients
beats.visual_fingerprint: tight ground-level harvest scene in a shaded tropical plant patch, hands lifting leafy greens and bright fruit into a simple basket, distant beach meal blurred into the upper background, renewed daylight contrast
beats.continuity: shift from deterioration to a constructive source of additional dietary variety

beats.narration_slice: Clean drinking water is essential every day.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut of clear collected rainwater pouring from a broad tropical leaf into a clean coconut-shell vessel, with muddy standing water visibly separated in the distant background.
beats.purpose: show the daily importance of a clean drinking-water source
beats.visual_fingerprint: extreme close-up of a clear water stream entering a coconut-shell cup, diagonal composition beneath rain-wet leaves, cool turquoise and bone-white highlights, muddy puddle small and distant
beats.continuity: move from food variety to another essential daily survival requirement in a different island zone

beats.narration_slice: Shelter protects you from heat, rain, and storms.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut wide shot of a sturdy palm-frond shelter on raised dry ground as hard rain slants across the beach and wind bends nearby palms, while the interior remains protected.
beats.purpose: show shelter reducing exposure to tropical weather hazards
beats.visual_fingerprint: wide exterior storm scene from a high three-quarter angle, compact palm-frond shelter centered on raised sand, diagonal rain and bent palms framing it, storm-gray sky with deep indigo carved shadows
beats.continuity: leave the close water detail for a broad environmental survival need as weather intensifies

beats.narration_slice: Injuries or infections can become dangerous without medical care.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut close scene of an injured bare foot with a small cut being rinsed and wrapped using simple clean cloth, while a distant empty horizon underscores the absence of professional medical help.
beats.purpose: show why untreated injury or infection is a serious survival risk
beats.visual_fingerprint: tight side-on treatment scene at ground level, wounded foot and clean cloth dominating the foreground, sparse shoreline and empty sea horizon behind, restrained rust-orange accent confined to the injury
beats.continuity: move from protection against environmental hazards to a personal hazard that shelter and food cannot solve alone

beats.narration_slice: Even perfect nutrition cannot stop normal aging.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut of a healthy tropical tree shown with a thick, weathered trunk and fallen older leaves while fresh fruit still hangs above, using natural aging as a restrained metaphor rather than depicting illness.
beats.purpose: show that aging continues even when nourishment is adequate
beats.visual_fingerprint: low upward wide shot of an old fruit-bearing tropical tree at warm late-day light, deeply carved bark and fallen leaves in the foreground, healthy fruit overhead, quiet reflective composition
beats.continuity: shift from acute survival threats to the unavoidable long-term limit that nutrition cannot remove

beats.narration_slice: Plenty of food helps, but it cannot make you live forever.
beats.visual: Full-bleed linocut sunset scene of an abundant island food spread in the foreground while a long human-made trail of footprints crosses the beach and eventually disappears into the tide, conveying abundance alongside mortality without text.
beats.purpose: summarize that plentiful nutrition supports survival but does not eliminate mortality
beats.visual_fingerprint: very wide sunset beach composition with abundant fruit, fish and coconuts low in the foreground, a sweeping S-curve of footprints leading toward the surf and vanishing under incoming water, reflective storm-free horizon
beats.continuity: close in the same island world by pairing visible abundance with a separate visual reminder that life remains finite
